fs = [f for f in glob.glob("migrations/*.sql") if os.path.basename(f) != "001_init.sql"]
pat = re.compile(r'alter\s+table\s+(if\s+exists\s+)?("?\w+"?\.)?"?users"?\s+add\s+(column\s+)?(if\s+not\s+exists\s+)?"?last_login"?\b', re.I | re.S)
ok = any(pat.search(open(f, encoding="utf-8").read()) and os.path.basename(f) > "001_init.sql" for f in fs)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
